Options._comment_: ShowFirewallTable derives the network flows the appliance needs from its own configuration. Set to false to omit that section. ShowTopologyDiagram draws the trunk topology as a diagram. It needs the optional AsBuiltReport.Diagram module and is skipped with a warning when that is not installed. SkipCertificateCheck accepts the appliance certificate without validating it when collecting over REST, which most appliances need because they present a self signed certificate internally. Set to false where a trusted certificate is installed.

InfoLevel._comment_: 0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled / Summary, 2 = Adv Summary, 3 = Detailed, 4 = Adv Detailed, 5 = Comprehensive
